subject.title: fix(agents-bind): generate peer format for feishu group bindings

question: Which public Feishu bind grammar should OpenClaw support before any candidate PR for the Feishu group-routing bug lands?
rationale: The central fix changes a documented CLI input that writes persisted routing config, and the open candidate PRs make different account-versus-peer compatibility tradeoffs.

options.title: Require compatibility-safe bind grammar
options.body: Preserve documented account and channel-only bind semantics, then add either explicit peer syntax or plugin-owned Feishu conversation recognition with a clear account escape, docs, tests, and proof.

options.title: Accept Feishu two-segment peer default
options.body: Treat `feishu:<id>` as a conversation peer by default, but own the compatibility impact for existing Feishu account IDs and document the new `account:` escape.

options.title: Choose a sibling candidate
options.body: Pause this PR and adopt another open candidate if its grammar better matches the desired long-term contract, closing the rest only after one fix is viable or merged.

recommendation.title: Require compatibility-safe bind grammar
recommendation.body: Preserve documented account and channel-only bind semantics, then add either explicit peer syntax or plugin-owned Feishu conversation recognition with a clear account escape, docs, tests, and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans public docs, routing semantics, and CLI compatibility, all areas where this history pass shows recent related work.
